title.zh: Anthropic因美国出口管制令停用Fable 5和Mythos 5
title.en: Anthropic says it is disabling Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all customers after the US government issued an export control order, citing national security concerns

summary.zh: 美国政府以国家安全为由发布出口管制令，Anthropic宣布对所有客户停用Fable 5和Mythos 5。

title.zh: Siri AI缓解苹果AI危机，iOS 27内部版本已支持第三方AI模型
title.en: Siri AI is good enough to ease Apple's AI crisis; sources: the ability to tap third party AI models beyond OpenAI's is already active in internal iOS 27 builds

title.zh: 大科技公司、初创企业和政府押注2030年前实现商用量子计算
title.en: After years of false dawns, Big Tech, startups, and governments are betting on commercially useful quantum computers by 2030, as skeptics worry about hype

summary.zh: 尽管存在炒作担忧，各方仍在积极投资量子计算技术的商业化。

title.zh: AI热潮如何重塑美国股市，科技巨头削减回购并增加资本支出
title.en: How the AI boom is revolutionizing US stock markets, as hyperscalers cut buybacks and boost capex, including Alphabet's planned ~$85B in equity offerings for AI

summary.zh: 包括Alphabet计划约850亿美元的股票发行以支持AI发展。

title.zh: Satya Nadella：企业必须掌控AI学习循环以避免价值流失
title.en: Satya Nadella says companies must own their AI “learning loops” to compound human and token capital, or risk ceding all value to a handful of frontier models

summary.zh: 纳德拉强调企业需要掌控AI学习循环，否则可能将价值拱手让给少数前沿模型。

title.zh: 华为发布HarmonyOS 7，支持2000+专用AI代理并增强语音助手
title.en: Huawei unveils HarmonyOS 7, introducing an “agent-friendly” architecture that connects to 2,000+ specialized AI agents and features an enhanced voice assistant
